scope.description: Repository-relative files/directory prefixes to claim for writes; use . for the whole repo.

skills.description: Pinned skill names to include in this step prompt. Names must be available in the task catalog.

tools.description: Allowed native tools, e.g. read_file, search, write_file, apply_patch, command.

when.description: Optional condition on a direct dependency's terminal status.
